jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603 inventory: Stamford School District, a town school district in the Windham Southwest Supervisory Union (member town: Stamford). Operates PK-8; high school by choice.

board.post_note: Stamford SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b); the district's published term structure mixes standing 2-year and 3-year seats (recorded as published).

sources.note: Windham Southwest SU Stamford Board page (official, current version fetched 2026-10-22) with the board's approved March 24, 2026 reorganization minutes: five directors -- Lamore (Chair, 2-year term, 2027), Thomas (Vice Chair, 2-year, 2028), Rower (Clerk, 3-year, 2028), Desautels (3-year, 2027), Caruso (3-year, 2029). The March 2026 warning warned one 2-year and one 3-year seat. FLAG (seat arithmetic): the pre-election SU page labeled Danielle Smith's 3-year seat "Expires 2028," yet her seat was evidently the one filled in March 2026 for a fresh 3-year term (Caruso) -- either the older page mislabeled her expiry or she departed mid-term; the current roster rests on two post-election official sources. Smith is recorded ended 2026. Stamford's published structure mixes standing 2-year and 3-year seats, recorded as published. The vice chair is minted "Beth Thomas" (current page + 2026 minutes; older records render "Beth Thomas Phelps"). Resolving document for the arithmetic: the district's 2026 annual-meeting return.
